title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-005
doc_notes: This document consists of FAA investigative reports and interview notes regarding the Japan Airlines Flight 1628 UAP sighting, including handwritten sketches on the final pages.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 crew reported observing unidentified air traffic with yellow, amber, and green lights that paced their aircraft for approximately 50 minutes.
behavior: changed position from front to port side
lights changed from horizontal to vertical orientation
incidents.quote: Captain Terauchi stated the UAT was in front of his aircraft at a distance of approximately seven to eight nautical miles
